title: Republican behind Epstein files act responds to Trump ‘lowlife’ taunt
summary: Kentucky’s Thomas Massie used the president’s insult to raise funds to run against a Trump-endorsed candidate A Kentucky congressman singled out by Donald Trump on Christmas as a “lowlife” after co-authoring a law requiring the federal government to release all of its Jeffrey Epstein files says the president attacked him for keeping a commitment to “help victims”. Thomas Massie then successfully sought donations for his run for another term in the 2026 midterm elections against an opponent that Trump – his fellow Republican – has already endorsed.
